description: PRO KEY ONLY. Complete public history of changes (prices, availability, corrected values), beyond the 50 of `get_recent_changes`, filterable by robot (`slug`), kind and dates (`from`, `to`, YYYY-MM-DD). Paged with `offset`; `locale: "fr"` for French sentences. Without a pro key the answer points to https://vuntum.com/en/entreprise#demande.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.
